notes.title: Achievements unlocked!
notes.notes:
A lot of you asked for them, now we added Steam achievements to Derpy Conga!

Some of them are even unlocked retroactively if you would have gotten them in a prior play through. Just start the game again to get them.

Happy achievement hunting!

notes.title: Added Steam Cloud Support
notes.notes:
With Build 8244965, save files are now synced through Steam Cloud.

If you played the game before this update, you might have to move the save file to a new location for it to be recognized by the game.
To do so, follow this steps:
[olist]
[*]Go to C:\Users\UserName\AppData\LocalLow\Giant Door\derpyconga
[*]There should be two files named derpycongaSaveGame.bin and derpycongaSettings.json
[*]Make a backup of those two files just in case.
[*]At the location described at [1] there should also be a folder with a name made only with numbers (that's your account SteamID)
[*]Remove the "derpyconga" part from the two files mentioned at [2] name (so you have SaveGame.bin and Settings.json) and put them in the folder mentioned at [4] (eventually overwrite if there are already files with the same name in there).
[*]Start the game and your progress should be recovered.
[/olist]
